item.title: Calls to reinstate 24/7 paramedic car in Monaghan
item.description: Local TD Cathy Bennett has raised her concerns over the failure to reinstate an advanced paramedic car for the people of Monaghan. Deputy Bennett said it was brought to her attention that ambulance staff in Monaghan are operating without an advanced paramedic car. As a result, this has caused delays in handovers and ambulance personnel feeling "over worked" and "burnt out." item.title: Cavan doctor named as Grand Marshall of Waterford’s St. Patrick’s Day Parade
item.description: A Co Cavan native has been announced as Grand Marshall of Waterford’s St. Patrick’s Day Parade. item.title: Public lighting upgrades to take place this weekend in Carrickmacross
item.description: The Cathaoirleach of Monaghan County Council has confirmed that long-awaited public lighting upgrades on Main Street, Carrickmacross, will commence this weekend. item.title: Cllr John Paul Feeley elected as chair of Cavan Community Safety Partnership
item.description: The newly established Cavan Local Community Safety Partnership (LCSP) held its inaugural meeting in the Hotel Kilmore on Wednesday the 28th of January, 2026. At the meeting Cllr. John Paul Feeley was elected Chairperson of the Partnership, and Cllr. TP O’Reilly was elected Vice-Chair. Both will serve a three year term from the date of appointment and will lead the partnership in its work to promote safer communities and foster trust and cooperation between all stakeholders. item.description: A group aiming to give men a safe space to share and receive support is meeting this weekend. item.title: Cavan resident may have no choice but live in her car
item.description: A Co Cavan resident says she will be forced to live in her car if she can't find another home to rent. Rebecca Lambe who has lived in Virginia for the last 10 years says she received an eviction notice before Christmas. She says the new legislation that's been brought in for landlords in the coming weeks is the reason behind her home going on the market. item.title: Local Senator on My Future Fund in Cavan and Monaghan
item.description: More than 22,000 workers in Cavan and Monaghan have been signed up to the new Auto Enrolment Retirement Savings System since its launch on 1 January. Fine Gael Senator Joe O'Reilly said 12,082 employees in Cavan and 10,476 in Monaghan are now enrolled in the scheme. Nationally, almost 763,000 workers have been automatically signed up to My Future Fund in just over a month. item.title: Monaghan and Cavan in Lidl league action
item.description: Monaghan and Cavan both have home games in round three of the Lidl Ladies league. A repeat of last year’s Division 3 final pits Cavan against Wexford. There have been contrasting fortunes for the promoted pair so far in Division 2. Advertisement Wexford are one of three teams yet to register a point while Cavan, in contrast, are unbeaten and with four points on the board to date. item.title: Appeal issued for Cavan teenager
item.description: Gardaí are seeking the public’s assistance in tracing the whereabouts of Calum Gibson (16) who was reported missing from Stradone, Co. Cavan on Tuesday 3rd February 2026. Calum is described as being approximately 5 foot 9 inches in height, of slim build with brown hair and brown eyes. When last seen Calum was wearing a light grey and black tracksuit.
